Statewide library visits per resident in Victoria

Source: R/data.R
vic_visits.Rd

Annual library visits per resident for Victoria from 2022-23 to 2024-25. These figures provide the statewide benchmark for comparing library services.

Usage

vic_visits

Format

A data frame with 3 rows and 2 columns:

financial_year

Financial year, from 2022-23 to 2024-25.

visits_per_person

Total Victorian library visits divided by the Victorian population.

Source

Public Libraries Victoria, 2024-25 Annual Statistical Survey, Final Datasets 2022-23 to 2024-25. https://www.plv.org.au/resources/earlier-reports-and-surveys/ Data © Public Libraries Victoria.

Details

The statewide rate uses total Victorian library visits divided by total population, rather than the average of individual service rates. PLV's statewide totals include estimates for services that did not report.

Examples

vic_visits
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>   financial_year visits_per_person
#>   <chr>                      <dbl>
#> 1 2022-23                     3.05
#> 2 2023-24                     3.37
#> 3 2024-25                     3.48
